_note: Corrections applied to every book as it is read and voiced. Edit this file, re-run gerel_voice.py and gerel_build.py, and the fix reaches all 287 books at once. Nothing inside the EPUBs is altered — they stay exactly as the library published them.

_how.text: Fixes a genuine typo. Changes what is shown AND what is spoken. Use sparingly: this alters someone else's published text.
_how.say: Fixes only how a word is pronounced. The page still shows the original. Use freely — abbreviations, numerals, foreign names.
